I reviewed the executed music and archive license this morning, and there are important restrictions: the festival may hold exactly one in-person public screening, we may NOT publish any trailer or excerpt online, and we must use the exact credit 'Courtesy of Northline Archive.' I hadn't added the license summary to the programming file yet because the signed copy just arrived in my separate clearance inbox. The draft program currently plans a public screening and an online trailer, so the trailer needs to be pulled before we lock anything.

I haven't updated the submission record yet because the database correction queue is still open, but this needs to be resolved before the program is locked.

Given both issues, I'm inclined to pull it from competition entirely and offer it as a single special screening — one in-person screening, no online trailer, with the required archive credit. Does either of you see any problem with that approach before I make the final call?
